theorems.name: Submission.p06_9e0f5043ff_fosa_coefficients_integral_off_finite
theorems.statement: ∀ (K E : Type*) [Field K] [Field E] [Algebra K E], (∀ a : E, a ≠ 0 → {v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K E | v.ord a ≠ 0}.Finite) → ∀ P : Polynomial E, ∃ T : Set (AlgebraicCurve.Place K E), T.Finite ∧ ∀ v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K E, v ∉ T → ∀ i : ℕ, P.coeff i ∈ v.toValuationSubring
theorems.natural_summary: Take the finite union of the order supports of the polynomial's nonzero coefficients. Outside this union, each nonzero coefficient has order zero, so the existing unit–uniformizer factorization identifies it with a valuation-subring unit. Zero coefficients belong to every valuation subring.
